newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade with most traders sidelined ahead of tonight's 1315 GMT release of the U.S. August industrial production and capacity utilisation data, dealers said on Tuesday.
Industrial production for August is forecast to show an increase of 0.4 percent compared with a 0.1 percent gain reported in July.
August capacity utilisation is expected to rise to 83.3 percent against July's 83.2 percent.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. The market is now waiting for possible direction from tonight's industrial production and capacity utilisation numbers," a local dealer said.

"But I don't think there will be much impact here as most people are waiting for the the outcome of the Federal Open Market Committee meeting which starts on September 24 for more clues to market direction," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday, Wednesday/Thursday and week-fixed were unchanged from Monday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.
Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16, six-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 and twelve-months unchanged at 6 5-7/8 percent.
